  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "alarms_cleared",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "old units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface and enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "On the old units: disable the interface and enable it again. Don't reboot.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Traffic back."
  },
  "reason": "The expert states a tested operational rule to bounce the interface rather than rebooting on old units when counters remain at zero after an SFP replacement."
}
